gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-palmyrene: Noto Sans Palmyrene reads clean and modern, its curves stopping short of closing and its ascenders kept compact. And Tilt Neon sets the opposite tone, a tube-like heading whose stroke never changes width, so the text beneath feels like a quiet reply.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-pau-cin-ha: Commanding from the first glance, Tilt Neon draws every letter like a single neon tube with a splayed c. But Noto Sans Pau Cin Hau is the one that breathes, with open-ended curves and capitals that barely rise above the lowercase.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-phagspa: That bent-paperclip stroke, with no thick-thin shifts, is pure Tilt Neon. Noto Sans PhagsPa follows with see-through openings and a gentle bump up to its capitals, so long lines of text feel approachable and contemporary.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-phoenician: Tilt Neon brings a wire-like monoline heading with a big x-height and short ascenders. Then Noto Sans Phoenician steps in with s curves open at both ends, and the two sit together like a loud sign over a modern, generous text.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-psalter-pa: Noto Sans Psalter Pahlavi has gaping e shapes and barely rising capitals. Its strongest pull is the friction with Tilt Neon, whose round letters carry walls as heavy as the straight ones.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-rejang: Tilt Neon has no modulation between its stems and connecting strokes, which gives the heading a bold, tube-drawn authority. And Noto Sans Rejang answers in porthole-wide lowercase with distinct gaps, so a modest size for the text lets those openings show.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-runic: Tilt Neon is the loud one, with stems and arches of identical thickness that command attention in a heading. Noto Sans Runic does the quieter job, using a big x-height and curves that never close back on themselves to carry the text.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-samaritan: Approachable and professional, Noto Sans Samaritan fills its hefty lowercase with plenty of daylight inside each curve, while Tilt Neon's bold lines sit above it. Paragraphs would read sturdy and friendly.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-saurashtra: Ruler-straight and bold. Tilt Neon holds one constant-width line, while Noto Sans Saurashtra, with its barely taller capitals and connected counters, feels like a hushed, clean companion standing beside it.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-sc: Tilt Neon stitches its strokes like thread along a path. Noto Sans SC feels softer beside it, with chalk curves stopping well before closing and ascenders that barely clear the x-height.
